using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry.Constants;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp;

public class AbpApplicationBaseTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Handle_TelemetryService_Exception_Gracefully()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockServiceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var mockScopeFactory = new Mock<IServiceScopeFactory>();
        var mockScope = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
        var mockScopeProvider = mockScope.Object.ServiceProvider;
        var mockTelemetryService = new Mock<ITelemetryService>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AbpApplicationBase>>();

        mockTelemetryService
            .Setup(x => x.AddActivityAsync(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Telemetry failure"));

        mockScopeProvider
            .Setup(x => x.GetRequiredService<ITelemetryService>())
            .Returns(mockTelemetryService.Object);

        mockScopeFactory
            .Setup(x => x.CreateScope())
            .Returns(mockScope.Object);

        mockServiceProvider
            .Setup(x => x.GetService<IServiceScopeFactory>())
            .Returns(mockScopeFactory.Object);

        mockServiceProvider
            .As<IServiceProviderIsService>()
            .Setup(x => x.IsService(typeof(IServiceScopeFactory)))
            .Returns(true);

        services.AddSingleton<IServiceProvider>(mockServiceProvider.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IConfiguration>(new Mock<IConfiguration>().Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IAbpHostEnvironment>(new Mock<IAbpHostEnvironment>().Object);

        var application = new TestAbpApplication(typeof(object), services);

        // Set ServiceProvider after construction to avoid DI conflicts
        application.SetServiceProvider(mockServiceProvider.Object);

        // Act
        await application.SetupTelemetryTrackingAsync();

        // Assert - no exception thrown, telemetry call attempted
        mockTelemetryService.Verify(x => x.AddActivityAsync(ActivityNameConsts.ApplicationRun), Times.Once);
        mockServiceProvider.Verify(x => x.CreateScope(), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Should_Handle_TelemetryService_Exception_Gracefully_Sync()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockServiceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var mockScopeFactory = new Mock<IServiceScopeFactory>();
        var mockScope = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
        var mockScopeProvider = mockScope.Object.ServiceProvider;
        var mockTelemetryService = new Mock<ITelemetryService>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AbpApplicationBase>>();

        mockTelemetryService
            .Setup(x => x.AddActivityAsync(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Telemetry failure"));

        mockScopeProvider
            .Setup(x => x.GetRequiredService<ITelemetryService>())
            .Returns(mockTelemetryService.Object);

        mockScopeFactory
            .Setup(x => x.CreateScope())
            .Returns(mockScope.Object);

        mockServiceProvider
            .Setup(x => x.GetService<IServiceScopeFactory>())
            .Returns(mockScopeFactory.Object);

        mockServiceProvider
            .As<IServiceProviderIsService>()
            .Setup(x => x.IsService(typeof(IServiceScopeFactory)))
            .Returns(true);

        services.AddSingleton<IServiceProvider>(mockServiceProvider.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IConfiguration>(new Mock<IConfiguration>().Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IAbpHostEnvironment>(new Mock<IAbpHostEnvironment>().Object);

        var application = new TestAbpApplication(typeof(object), services);
        application.SetServiceProvider(mockServiceProvider.Object);

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = Assert.Throws<AggregateException>(() => application.SetupTelemetryTracking());
        Assert.Contains("Telemetry failure", exception.InnerException?.Message ?? "");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShouldSendTelemetryData_When_Development_And_TelemetryEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = CreateServicesWithScope(
            env => env.IsDevelopment().Returns(true),
            config => config.Setup(x => x.GetValue<bool?>("Abp:Telemetry:IsEnabled")).Returns(true)
        );
        var application = new TestAbpApplication(typeof(object), services);

        // Act
        var result = application.ShouldSendTelemetryData();

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShouldNotSendTelemetryData_When_NotDevelopment()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = CreateServicesWithScope(
            env => env.IsDevelopment().Returns(false),
            config => { }
        );
        var application = new TestAbpApplication(typeof(object), services);

        // Act
        var result = application.ShouldSendTelemetryData();

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShouldNotSendTelemetryData_When_TelemetryDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = CreateServicesWithScope(
            env => env.IsDevelopment().Returns(true),
            config => config.Setup(x => x.GetValue<bool?>("Abp:Telemetry:IsEnabled")).Returns(false)
        );
        var application = new TestAbpApplication(typeof(object), services);

        // Act
        var result = application.ShouldSendTelemetryData();

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    private ServiceCollection CreateServicesWithScope(
        Action<Mock<IAbpHostEnvironment>> envSetup,
        Action<Mock<IConfiguration>> configSetup)
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockEnv = new Mock<IAbpHostEnvironment>();
        var mockConfig = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
        
        envSetup(mockEnv);
        configSetup(mockConfig);

        var mockScopeFactory = new Mock<IServiceScopeFactory>();
        var mockScope = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
        mockScope.Setup(x => x.Dispose());
        mockScopeFactory.Setup(x => x.CreateScope()).Returns(mockScope.Object);

        var mockScopeProvider = mockScope.Object.ServiceProvider;
        mockScopeProvider.Setup(x => x.GetRequiredService<IAbpHostEnvironment>()).Returns(mockEnv.Object);
        mockScopeProvider.Setup(x => x.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>()).Returns(mockConfig.Object);

        services.AddSingleton<IServiceProvider>(new Mock<IServiceProvider>().Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IAbpHostEnvironment>(mockEnv.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<IConfiguration>(mockConfig.Object);

        return services;
    }

    private class TestAbpApplication : AbpApplicationBase
    {
        public TestAbpApplication(Type startupModuleType, IServiceCollection services)
            : base(startupModuleType, services, null)
        {
        }

        public new IServiceProvider ServiceProvider
        {
            get => base.ServiceProvider;
            set => base.SetServiceProvider(value);
        }

        public void SetServiceProvider(IServiceProvider provider)
        {
            SetServiceProvider(provider);
        }

        public bool ShouldSendTelemetryData() => base.ShouldSendTelemetryData();

        public new async Task SetupTelemetryTrackingAsync() => 
            await base.SetupTelemetryTrackingAsync();

        public new void SetupTelemetryTracking() => 
            base.SetupTelemetryTracking();
    }
}
